summary: Composites input images by adding pixel values, clamping color channels above 1, with transform controls for the overlay layer.

key_params.name: size
key_params.note: Fixed layer, input1 or input2, whose resolution/aspect drive output

key_params.name: prefit
key_params.note: Overlay fit mode such as fill, fithorz, fitvert, fitbest, fitoutside, or nativeres

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Overlay extend behavior: hold, zero, repeat, or mirror

common_gotchas: Additive compositing clamps color channels over 1 unless the surrounding pipeline preserves extended range intentionally.
Transform-page parameters affect only the overlay layer; they do not transform the fixed layer or the formula.
Fixed Layer choice affects output size and aspect, which can surprise downstream composites.
Use Native Resolution when the overlay must remain pixel-accurate.
key_concepts: Add TOP performs additive compositing: output pixels are Input1 plus Input2.
Color channels clamp when the added value exceeds 1, so float/HDR workflows need downstream range planning.
The Fixed Layer selects which input drives default output resolution and aspect without changing the additive formula.
Transform parameters affect only the overlay input, not both inputs.
Native Resolution prefit is the pixel-accurate overlay mode for preserving source resolution.
The official TOP supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
